external_climate_devices.title: External climate devices

external_temperature_sensors.title: Temperature sensor feedback
external_temperature_sensors.description: Assign one temperature sensor from each eligible room's matching Home Assistant area and configure its boost behaviour.

data_description.external_temperature_tolerance: Start a boost only when the measured temperature is more than this far below the scheduled target.
data_description.external_temperature_boost_duration: How long each boost created by temperature feedback should run.
data_description.external_temperature_stale_minutes: Ignore the sensor and stop feedback control when it has not updated within this time.

data_description.legacy_naming: Inclui os nomes das divisões nos nomes dos dispositivos Wiser. Se estiver ativado, ao utilizar o Home Assistant para regenerar os ID de entidade com o formato predefinido em Definições → Sistema → Formato do ID de entidade (Home Assistant 2026.8 e posterior), os nomes das áreas serão duplicados quando coincidirem com os nomes das divisões Wiser. Alterar esta opção não muda o nome dos ID de entidade existentes.
data_description.wiser_climate_more_info: Apply Wiser demand and passive-mode styling to Wiser room Thermostat cards and the climate control inside More Info, using the same theme variables. Home Assistant's native temperature handling, dialog, history and settings are retained.
